executiveSummary: Iranian-affiliated APTs are actively exploiting internet-exposed PLCs (Rockwell, Schneider, Siemens), modifying logic and HMI data in US Water and Energy, causing real operational disruption. Immediate removal of PLCs from the internet, mode locks, and OT segmentation are critical. Security Advisory CISA warns of a surge in WWS incidents where adversaries lock out operators by changing PLC credentials and IPs; undocumented cellular modem paths are a recurring weak point. Prioritize exposure hunts, strong auth, and jump-hosted access. Alert A novel OT intrusion pathway via misconfigured private cellular APNs enabled a December 2025 turbine and water-treatment shutdown in Poland's energy sector; similar APN risks likely exist globally in distributed OT estates. Supporting Report Widely deployed edge and management platforms are under active exploitation or KEV action: VMware vCenter RCE (persistence via reverse_ssh), Citrix NetScaler pre-auth RCE (public PoC), Fortinet "FortiBleed" leaked device credentials, and Cisco FMC hard-coded password. View Article Security Advisory Multiple CISA weekly bulletins enumerate high-impact OT CVEs: unauthenticated Modbus/TCP access on Delta PLCs, industrial data acquisition RCE (ibaPDA), and EVSE/OCPP flaws (Autel, EVbee) that could disrupt operations if exposed. Bulletin Bulletin Nation-state pre-positioning persists: China-nexus actors leverage covert SOHO/IoT proxy networks to stage access to CNI; Russia-linked units abuse router/SNMP/Smart-Install misconfigurations for credential theft and traffic capture. Advisory Advisory Targeted supply chain and collaboration stack risks: Head Mare APT exploits TrueConf to deliver ICS-relevant backdoors; Cl0p claims PTC Windchill/FlexPLM data theft (engineering docs); Zimbra zero-day mass-exfiltration is active. Supporting Report View Article OT-adjacent botnet pressure: a new Mirai strain ("Evooo1Bot") exploits multiple router/RTU CVEs including Mitsubishi/INEA ME-RTU used in water/SCADA, turning victims into SOCKS proxies and DDoS nodes. relevance: Direct OT impact confirmed: PLC logic manipulation (US WWS/Energy) and Poland turbine/water-treatment shutdown via private APN exposure. OT-adjacent vectors: exploitation of vCenter, NetScaler, FortiGate/FMC, LoadMaster, Cisco ASA/FTD DoS, and Zimbra/SharePoint identity paths enabling IT→OT pivots. Operational technologies at risk: Delta Electronics PLCs, ibaPDA acquisition, EVSE/OCPP, building automation (Johnson Controls/Siemens), video management (Siveillance), OPC UA stacks (Eclipse Milo). Supply chain/documentation exposure (PTC Windchill/FlexPLM, TrueConf APT) elevates targeting precision against industrial sites.

outlook72h: Prioritize emergency patching and hunts on: vCenter (CVE-2026-59310), NetScaler (CVE-2026-8452), FortiGate/FortiOS (FortiBleed exposure), Cisco FMC hard-coded password KEV, Progress LoadMaster KEV. Immediate external-attack-surface sweep for VNC, PLC ports (102/502/2222/44818), OCPP endpoints, and router/SNMP/Smart-Install exposure. Apply controller mode locks, rotate PLC/HMI and vendor remote credentials, and validate OT backups/golden logic images offline. Increase monitoring for reverse_ssh beacons, webshell paths (/var/vpn/theme/*.php), anomalous SAML payload sizes, and abnormal OCPP/AMQP traffic.
